other_conditions: Must have passed Std X with a minimum 80 percentile in the Gujarat board examination for diploma admissions
Must have passed Std XII (Science/General) with a minimum 80 percentile in the Gujarat board examination for bachelor's degree programmes
For diploma‑to‑degree students, a minimum of 65% marks at the diploma level examination from a recognized university in Gujarat is required
Parents' annual income must not exceed Rs 6,00,000
A valid income certificate is accepted for three financial years from the date of issue
Hostel grant is applicable only for admissions in other Taluka
Tuition fee grant is applicable only for self‑finance courses
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for tuition fees, hostel accommodation, and books/instruments to eligible students pursuing higher education in Gujarat.
